findings.evidence: ET0 fixture (Plex Sans only): comp validate valid, comp render rendered, warnings [], systemFontLayers []; the Thai-only line has 4,040 ink pixels painted by a face outside the composition. main already has the cmap reader (font-cmap.ts, formats 4/12, added fbf9460c 2026-10-10), font identity and inspectFontText with legacy/strict profiles, and reachable-copy collection including compositionFontTextRuns. Called directly in strict mode, inspectFontText reports font-coverage errors naming U+0E04, U+0E25, U+0E38 for each layer. It is enforced for mechanism-episode font dependencies (packages/animation-engine/src/mechanism/io.ts), but the composition renderer calls loadCompositionFonts(composition, assetUrl, undefined, ...) and comp validate/render have no strict font option, so the composition route never runs it.

findings.evidence: Composition quality rules still have no text-contrast rule. ET0 fixture: the band is under the credit on frames 27–47 and under the line on frames 33–55, exactly as the generator predicts; ink-to-background contrast falls to 1.16:1, below 3:1 on frames 29–45 (credit) and 37–51 (line). State and pixel lint report no finding about it (pixel lint passes).
reading-time errors in both modes: T1 0.125 s, T2 0.083 s, T3 0 s of readable time against 1.00 s.

State lint with the clip no longer reports frozen-run over footage-only spans (the proof's T2 157–167 finding is gone). Pixel mode, now working, reports frozen-pixels over footage-only spans (T1 1–15 and 148–167, T2 154–167, T3 1–16 and 144–167). Measured on the proof clip: mean absolute inter-frame luma difference is at most 0.002 of 255 over frames 144–167 and exactly 0 at frames 156–157 and 163–167, so the encoded footage is effectively static there and the pixel-mode report is plausibly correct. The ET0 synthetic clip, which drifts every frame, produces no frozen-pixels finding with video.
